rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and notes zona thinning, but it overstates certainty about a distinct tightly packed ICM and cohesive TE from this single image and speculates about debris/degeneration not clearly demonstrable.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian response, prior miscarriage, sperm quality, diagnosis, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo morphology and prognosis.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with age-related aneuploidy appropriately emphasized; minor issues include somewhat arbitrary probability adjustments and overinterpretation of morphology.

Much is aligned with standard IVF counseling, but several recommendations are weakly evidence-based or not routinely guideline-supported (endometrial scratch, ERA after a single miscarriage, NK/immunologic testing, aspirin/estradiol without clear indication, broad PGT-A advocacy).
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and future planning, but some suggested interventions are not strongly evidence-based and may reduce practical appropriateness.
